name: 710 Labs Prepackaged Flower | Z
description: To create our proprietary Noodle Doinks, we first break up nugs by hand, then hand-roll with a gluten-free rotini noodle for the best airflow – no cones or machine fills. We use all organic flower from our premium top colas, no lowers, no shake. With a perfect bud-to-paper ratio, our Noodle Doinks are prepared fresh daily.
